entities.summary: Mandya is a city in the state of Karnataka. It is the headquarters of Mandya district. It is also called Sugar City because sugarcane is a major crop grown here, and sugar factories contribute to the major economic output. The district offices are located here. The city has been divided into 35 wards of the Mandya City Municipal Council.
